programme.title: The Fading Gold
programme.desc: [With English and Chinese subtitles] Yeung-tin collapses. Lam Ching hosts the press conference by herself and declares she won’t resign as trust executor. Meanwhile, Yau-wai incites craftsmen to collectively resign. Under the guidance of Ko Sham, Lam Ching uses kindness and coercion to negotiate with the employees.

programme.title: 金式森林
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】仰天倒下，林澄独自主持记者会，坚决表明不会辞任信托执行人。同时，有为成功煽动工匠集体辞职，在高深指导下，林澄恩威并施与师傅们谈判。伟梁带同金师傅来到仰天款待李夫人的晚宴，意图揭露工场困境。不过，仰天与高深早已布局，彻底粉碎伟梁的奸计……另边厢，嘉欣因被旧经理人Mary姐勒索，潜入高深办公室偷窃被当场逮住；高深还暗示，他早已知悉嘉欣的一个秘密……

programme.title: The Fading Gold
programme.desc: [With English and Chinese subtitles] In despair, Ka-yan recalls how she was bullied because of her ugly appearance, and she eventually married some rich guy as Sister Mary gave her a makeover. But from then on, she has been controlled and blackmailed by Sister Mary. Ko Sham uses Sister Mary’s unspeakable secret to counter blackmail her, helping Ka-yan resolve the blackmail crisis.

programme.title: 金式森林
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】嘉欣在绝望中回忆起自己因外貌丑陋而受尽欺凌，最终靠Mary姐打造而成功嫁入豪门，却也从此受Mary姐的控制与勒索。高深以其不可告人的秘密反向威胁Mary姐，替嘉欣解除勒索危机……学勤怂恿芷茵偷取仰天的药物，以取得官司胜算。林澄、仰天成功劝服芷茵，此时却有车手抢走药丸。

programme.title: The Scarecrow
programme.desc: Kang Tae Ju (Park Hae Soo), a former ace detective demoted to his hometown of Gangseong. He sees a serial murder case as an opportunity to restore his reputation, but clashes with prosecutor Cha Si Young (Lee Hee Joon), a bitter rival from his school days.

programme.title: 稻草人
programme.desc: 姜泰周（朴海秀饰）曾是王牌刑警，却被贬回故乡江城。他将一桩连环杀人案视为重振名声的机会，却与学生时代的宿敌今日的检察官车时英（李熙俊饰）发生冲突。

programme.title: Your Honor
programme.desc: Kim Eun invites Ho-young for a family dinner at her home. At her wits’ end, Prosecutor Kang reveals the truth to Ji-young. Can Pan-ho stop Ho-young in time, before it is too late?

programme.title: 法官大人
programme.desc: 金恩邀请浩英到她家共进家庭晚餐。不知如何是好的姜检察官向智英透露了真相。判昊能及时阻止浩英做出无法挽回的傻事吗？

programme.title: 幸福来了
programme.desc: 高家兄弟因为价值观截然不同，不但成就高低立判，连教育出来的子女，个性和品格也大相径庭。上一代有上一代的恩怨情报，下一代有下一代的追求展望；在错综复杂的人生大道上，每个人都汲汲营营，寻找着属于自己的幸福课题。

programme.title: The Fading Gold
programme.desc: [With English and Chinese subtitles] Yeung-tin collapses. Lam Ching hosts the press conference by herself and declares she won’t resign as trust executor. Meanwhile, Yau-wai incites craftsmen to collectively resign. Under the guidance of Ko Sham, Lam Ching uses kindness and coercion to negotiate with the employees.

programme.title: 金式森林
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】仰天倒下，林澄独自主持记者会，坚决表明不会辞任信托执行人。同时，有为成功煽动工匠集体辞职，在高深指导下，林澄恩威并施与师傅们谈判。伟梁带同金师傅来到仰天款待李夫人的晚宴，意图揭露工场困境。不过，仰天与高深早已布局，彻底粉碎伟梁的奸计……另边厢，嘉欣因被旧经理人Mary姐勒索，潜入高深办公室偷窃被当场逮住；高深还暗示，他早已知悉嘉欣的一个秘密……

programme.title: The Fading Gold
programme.desc: [With English and Chinese subtitles] In despair, Ka-yan recalls how she was bullied because of her ugly appearance, and she eventually married some rich guy as Sister Mary gave her a makeover. But from then on, she has been controlled and blackmailed by Sister Mary. Ko Sham uses Sister Mary’s unspeakable secret to counter blackmail her, helping Ka-yan resolve the blackmail crisis.

programme.title: 金式森林
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】嘉欣在绝望中回忆起自己因外貌丑陋而受尽欺凌，最终靠Mary姐打造而成功嫁入豪门，却也从此受Mary姐的控制与勒索。高深以其不可告人的秘密反向威胁Mary姐，替嘉欣解除勒索危机……学勤怂恿芷茵偷取仰天的药物，以取得官司胜算。林澄、仰天成功劝服芷茵，此时却有车手抢走药丸。

programme.title: The Scarecrow
programme.desc: Kang Tae Ju (Park Hae Soo), a former ace detective demoted to his hometown of Gangseong. He sees a serial murder case as an opportunity to restore his reputation, but clashes with prosecutor Cha Si Young (Lee Hee Joon), a bitter rival from his school days.

programme.title: 稻草人

Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: 杀手三分半钟
programme.desc: 职业杀手雷振华在尖东某夜总会成功杀死黑道名流四哥等人后，悄然来到马来西亚并住进唐人街对面一旧式旅馆。唐人街的豪华酒店里正举行一个盛大婚礼，新郎石先生正是雷计画用三分半钟解决的目标，不料，未等雷下手，另一杀手已捷足先登，倒在地上却是另一要人，雷顿时成了替罪羊。

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: 儿女是我们的
programme.desc: 富家小姐梅淑卿与穷教师江少文，为了自由恋爱，脱离父母，从城市迁往小镇结婚生活。他们生育五个儿女，但生存的担子日重，二人长期辛劳，终相继亡故。小儿女顿失庇荫，直接面对复杂的社会，几乎各散东西……

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: 五遁忍术
programme.desc: 黑道帮主康联兴觊觎武林盟主地位，竟以东瀛武士挑战武林总盟盟主袁增；一场酣战，东瀛武士落败，切腹自杀，死前留下遗书嘱康联兴聘请忍者之王剑渊为其复仇。剑渊率领大批忍者前来中土，摆下「五遁阵」，向袁增挑战。袁增派遣门下八位高手前去破阵，却因对忍术一无所知，全部被杀。剑渊取得胜利后意犹未足，派出女忍者纯子混入总盟作内应，并将康联兴杀死，以图称霸武林...

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: 林冲夜奔
programme.desc: 此片述说了关于林冲的故事。宋朝禁军教头林冲遭受贪官陷害，被放逐沧州，更陷入险境。幸得花和尚相助，林冲成功脱险，更展开复仇大计。

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: 烂头何
programme.desc: 青年侠盗何真看上歌妓翠红，翠却已被京城富豪王亲勤包起；王武功高强，深藏不露，实为康熙皇帝第十一子乔装；王见何为人率直重义气，且盗亦有道，故何虽多番放肆，王亦不以为忤；何本为官府通缉犯，王却暗中助其脱身；王此举无非望何改邪归正，但何不知收敛，王遂以计制之；后四太子为夺取皇权，把兄弟一一谋杀，特派梁将军谋杀王，何遂出手相助...

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: 三十年细说从头
programme.desc: 大导演李翰祥改编自己大受欢迎的专栏，尽现电影圈光怪陆离的趣事及传闻，由爱将刘永和戴良纯扮演不同角色，保证令你捧腹大笑。

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: 七煞
programme.desc: 由七位坛主控制的「七煞会」，在江湖上掀起腥风血雨, 人人闻风丧胆。朝廷特派刑部尚书杨宇统筹剿灭，并派卧底从内瓦解组织，随着「七煞会」内冲突不断升温，幕后坛主可会找出卧底？

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: 港澳传奇
programme.desc: 澳门古玩店老板，识破老婆与估衣铺老板有染后，威胁胡帮他引诱垂涎已久的王妻；香港赌徒在澳赌场邂逅流黑市夫人，事后恬要求与石同居，结局出人意表...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: 金石情
programme.desc: 刘贞莲不幸身患麻疯，其父刘员外招赘穷书生李孝文为婿，意图卖疯传毒。贞莲将真相和盘托出，孝文感于贞莲真情，决意回乡禀明母亲，迎接贞莲返家。孝文走后，贞莲万念俱灰，竟狂饮毒酒，以图自尽...

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all…

programme.title: 黑店
programme.desc: 故事讲述，江湖上传出消息，巡抚海刚峰辞官归里，所携箱箧中珠宝价值连城，于是引起了一些歹人的觊觎。高家店店主高山峰、其姘妇邓三娘，以及数帮黑道人物，均于高家店埋伏，准备等待海刚峰经过之时伺机下手…

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: 死角
programme.desc: 故事描述，狄龙与姜大卫游车河时，遇富家女李菁的跑车抛锚，狄载她返家，一见钟情。后李往姜之修车厂取车，再遇狄，狄约李去跳舞，夜总会中，碰见李兄陈鸿烈，陈不喜欢狄，故二人只好提早离去；归家途中，目击员警追捕逃犯，逃犯掉下之手枪，被狄检到，从此改变他的命?..

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: 蒙面大侠
programme.desc: 汉高祖死后,吕后专权,密诏太尉设法杀死代王刘恒。蒙面大侠发现其诡计后，马上告知刘恒。刘于是急遣护卫保护公主往长安求援。太尉率大队军马沿途追杀公主,幸得蒙面大侠保护,处处化险为夷。最后，蒙面大侠更助刘恒成功继承汉室大统。

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永卖身传员外家，为奴以埋父骨；其孝心感动了七仙女，便幻成村姑，在六位仙姐下凡暗助下，为董缩减偿还工作日，回复自由后，二人回董故家，但愉快的凡间生活能持续多久呢？

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: 群英会
programme.desc: 本片由三个单元故事组成，为岳枫、程刚及张彻联合执导，当年就有「花一张票价，看三套电影」的称誉。岳枫之〈铁弓缘〉讲述一对青年男女因一把铁弓而结缘、程刚之〈胭脂虎〉讲述一群绝色妓女的故事、张彻之〈白水滩〉讲述梁山英雄后代的故事。

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: 珠光宝气
programme.desc: 一名商人的私生女，无意中擦出神仙阿宝，并得到三个愿望。可惜阿宝法术不精，而发生了很多啼笑皆非的事。

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: 武状元苏乞儿
programme.desc: 苏乞儿原为贵族，但因上京考武状元时作弊，被眨为乞儿。苏乞儿在机缘巧合下救了丐帮长老，并接任为新帮主。一天，皇上狩猎之时，差点被暗杀，幸苏乞儿及时救驾。皇帝欲恢复其官职时，苏乞儿却拒绝。其后，皇上御赐一个乞儿钵予苏乞儿，从此他过着愉快的行乞生活。

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: 倾城之恋
programme.desc: 本片由香港导演许鞍华执导，改编自著名小说家张爱玲的同名小说，是一个发生在日军入侵香港期间的爱情故事。一个内向的上海离婚女子和一个愤世嫉俗的马来西亚花花公子互相倾慕。但因时局动荡，两人多次被迫分开，最终能否有情人终成眷属?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: 混世四猴：神猴归来
programme.desc: 世人心目中的救世主灵明石猴，曾给一位绝望中的小女孩一个从没兑现的希望，让她一直深深牵挂。直至多年后，灵明石猴在与三眼战神激战后，被打破金身堕入凡尘，因而丧失神力。灵明石猴能否补偿当年小女孩的承诺？又可会破坏木神祸乱人间的阴谋？

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: 男与女
programme.desc: 偷渡客孟思晨匿居于山边木屋区，沦为众男工具，期间结识非法拳师江远生，并发生雾水情缘。后来思晨下嫁中年木匠贵叔，生活虽安稳，心灵却空虚。意外再遇远生后，难免干柴烈火，未几更有孕...

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: 逃学威龙 2
programme.desc: 周星星遭降职后愤而辞去警职，私自潜入一所国际学校，调查国际恐怖分子的阴谋。期间，他意外发现探员达叔正假扮成教师。两人随即联手，共同对抗全副武装的罪犯，展开一场终极对决。

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: 一代宗师
programme.desc: 这部史诗式动作电影是由著名电影人王家卫执导。故事始于佛山，当时年迈的北方功夫宗师宫羽田公开挑战南方宗师叶问。叶问最终胜出，但后来输给宫羽田的女儿宫二，二人却因此结下情缘...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: 圣山村迷局
programme.desc: 平静的圣山村发生了一系列神秘事件，原本该下葬的尸体突然复活，而且拔足狂跑。全村马上展开追查行动，但这时村中恶霸却意外死亡，村长也失踪。于是警察接手调查，但当谜底快要解开时，村干部却又有惊天大发现。到底谁是幕后真凶？

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: 靓足100分
programme.desc: 林天赐的富商祖父病重，欲将遗产留给他，但条件是天赐要在一个月内结婚，否则遗产将归祖父侄儿罗伯特。不久天赐邂逅乐小小，两人渐生情愫。罗伯特即派玛丽琳利用美人计破坏他俩的感情。不料玛丽琳贪图遗产，准备真的与林结婚。罗心有不甘，捣乱婚礼，并揭发她的计谋...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: 我的野蛮同学
programme.desc: 在一间Band5学校有个打擂台的传统，学生会在课室将很多张书桌拼成一个擂台，在擂台上进行决胜去解决一切争执。四个性格各异的少年石头、Edward、亚凤、Seven意外地成为朋友，共同经历了难忘的成长体验...

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: 最佳女婿
programme.desc: 新潮发型屋少东 Happy 哥与死党赖布甸、龙眼仔, 因抢走上海理发店板大松客人, 与他发生口角. 一夜, 三人胡涂地与松女儿阿英醉宿一宵, 之后英意外怀孕, 不知是谁才是经手人, 惟有待孩子出世后, 以血型辨别亲父, 怎料三人皆属同一血型...

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: 封口者
programme.desc: 罗雪与男友吵架后，出走来到深山民宿与伊伊成为合租室友。一晚，罗雪无意中撞破依依及其友人雷松杀死依依的前男友。为免走漏消息，他们囚禁罗雪于阁楼中。罗雪的知己苏文发现她失踪后，到处找寻她的下落。最后，罗雪及苏文能否成功逃出险境?

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: 醉拳
programme.desc: 年轻气盛的黄飞鸿因招惹地方恶霸之子，被父亲送去跟随「醉拳大师」苏乞儿受训一年。当父亲揭发恶霸欲将国有矿产卖给日本人的阴谋后，顿成刺杀目标。为救父并阻止交易，飞鸿施展自创的「醉拳」，击败众杀手。

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: 无味神探
programme.desc: 故事根据真人实事改编，讲述香港督察刘镇海个性暴躁又好色，毒枭阿军欲杀他自保，但只令海失去味觉和嗅觉。妻子不忍见丈夫负伤累累因此尽释前嫌、尽心照顾。阿军得知海幷未身亡，胁持其妻作为谈判筹码。海为了救出妻子，只身一人与毒枭展开生死决战...

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。

programme.title: Global Watch
programme.desc: GLOBAL WATCH is a 60 minute-long news program. The show stresses Chinese elements, emphasizing China’s perspective, policies and stories. The program, relying on global reporting resources, presents in-depth analysis and coverage of major global issues, from a Chinese perspective on international affairs. The program presents to-the-point interpretation of Chinese policies and stories that are of interest to foreign audiences, in a style they are familiar with.

programme.title: Global Watch
programme.desc: GLOBAL WATCH is a 60 minute-long news program. The show stresses Chinese elements, emphasizing China’s perspective, policies and stories. The program, relying on global reporting resources, presents in-depth analysis and coverage of major global issues, from a Chinese perspective on international affairs. The program presents to-the-point interpretation of Chinese policies and stories that are of interest to foreign audiences, in a style they are familiar with.

programme.title: Big Story
programme.desc: Big Story is a documentary film program on CGTN. It explores global events with in a variety of filmic styles and featuring original, in-depth, thought-provoking storytelling. The program provides a unique platform for the best current affairs documentaries from around the globe. Big Story aims to present the contemporary world and China’s global perspectives on the contemporary world to an international audience.

programme.title: Big Story

SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。 世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(畲诗曼)。 顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。 世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: The Driving Power
programme.desc: MUI (CHENG SIU CHOW, ADAM) is a middle-aged man who has never had a proper job. Throughout his life, he has been relying on his family and living like a playboy. His biggest achievements are marrying a singer, YUNG (YIP TUNG, CECILIA) and raising their daughter CHU (YE MICHELLE). MUI and YUNG love each other very much even after being married for more than 20 years. However, deep down, MUI is still a playboy.

programme.title: 非常外父
programme.desc: 人到中年的丁贵妹(郑少秋)从未曾正正经经做事，四十多年来只懂倚仗江湖家族的背景，过着声色犬马的生活。妹半生最大的成就便是娶得歌女洛芙蓉(叶童)，以及养大女儿明珠(叶璇)。结婚二十多年，夫妻不错恩爱如昔，但是妹亦风流依旧。

programme.title: Treasure of Destiny
programme.desc: Pork butcher stall lady boss Chu Ying-kiu (Katy Kung) has innate mystical power. But she is inflicted with some strange illness that causes her to grow a beard. She hopes to find the elixir mentioned in Sutra of Forty-two Chapters for treating her illness. Over the years, university Chinese language professor Cheung King (Moses Chan) has been passionate about finding this legendary treasure. However, he has been suffering from insomnia as he was devastated in an incident.

programme.title: 新四十二章
programme.desc: 猪肉档老板娘朱萤娇(龚嘉欣饰)天生神力，却得了会生胡须的怪病，渴望寻找「四十二章经」宝藏内的神药治病。大学中文系教授章经(陈豪饰)多年前已醉心寻找这个传说中的宝藏，惟因一次事故大受打击，一直饱受失眠症困扰。数学天才邵桂芝(江嘉敏饰)机灵聪敏，对急症室病房男护士柯建宁(周嘉洛饰)一见倾心。桂芝游走于正邪之间，也极想找到宝藏，以求一朝发达。章经、萤娇和桂芝因缘际会之下相遇，为抢夺宝藏而各出奇谋，争夺过程中开展了人性的善恶争战，斗过你死我活……

programme.title: Guts of Man
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.title: 肝胆昆仑
programme.desc: 董斐(陈键锋)不理亡父遗训，乘姊姊岚(盖鸣晖)不觉时偷走出自幼居住的桃花村，途中结识了渔家子常欢(吴卓羲)。斐、欢到钱塘江观潮，斐对富家女邢晓雪(曹敏莉)一见钟情。 岚、斐意外发现父亲当年含冤而逝，为了为父讨回清白，二人在杭州住下。岚因调查而认识了佯装搭棚工人的节衡都尉狄英伟(元华)。伟义兄为沧洲五鬼所杀，伟为了方便调查而一直隐藏身分。调查下来，原来岚父之死，与沧洲五鬼及雪父均环环相扣。 另方面，斐、欢因为雪而闹翻，斐更因利欲熏心而重创岚……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper II
programme.desc: Overcoming adversity, LAW WAI-SHUN (Edwin Siu) and YIU MAN-YING (Kristal Tin) successfully develop the business of Lo Son Kei and make it famous in both Hong Kong and Macau. However, their success upsets a junket promoter-turned-land developer, KO TIN-TSAU (Hugo Ng), who keeps suppressing them. WAI-SHUN is even betrayed by his close confidant TSU CHI-LIK (Mat Yeung).

programme.title: 巨轮II
programme.desc: 罗威信（萧正楠）与姚文英（田蕊妮）几经艰辛，将「罗信记」发展得誉满港澳，却惹来迭码仔出身的地产商高天鹫（吴岱融）不满，施横手连翻打压，威信更被亲信徐知力（杨明）所出卖，感世俗混乱，遂到日本冲绳寻找宁静空间。期间，恋上了神秘少女高伊娜（陈凯琳），更卷入一宗廿年前离奇凶案！另一方面，文英丈夫龙飞（阮兆祥）遇上撞机意外，脑部受创，竟视文英为陌路人…加上为寻找旧爱卓静(钟嘉欣)的乔天生（陈展鹏）回归，威信与文英面对突如其来的亲情、爱情及事业的新冲击，应如何去面对？

programme.title: ONE GOOD TURN DESERVES ANOTHER
programme.desc: Young and beautiful Yee (Maggie Cheung) was held responsible for murdering a millionaire for his estate. She employed Shek (Chan Kai Tai) to defend for her. Shek was attracted to her mysterious background and fell for her seduction.

programme.title: 地狱天使
programme.desc: 年轻貌美的儿（张可颐），牵涉毒杀富翁及争夺遗产，找来石（陈启泰）当其辩护律师。儿的背景神秘复杂，且于有意无意间对石作出挑逗，令石留下深刻印象。 原来儿为石妻珊（苏玉华）之同父异母姐妹。儿因痛恨珊母当年抢走其父，致儿母沦为妓女，儿更惨遭嫖客强奸。儿誓要向珊母女二人进行报复。儿接近石，是为要珊婚姻决裂，家破人亡。 在儿的精心布局下，石渐转投其怀抱。儿见目标已达，欲抽身离去，却惊觉自己爱上了石。此时，儿情人关（何英伟）利用儿陷害石作其替死鬼，以掩饰其商业罪行……

programme.title: Colourful Life
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. His mistress, SHUI KWUN DING FUNG (TSUI SUJK YEE), has since been running the business and keeps the family in shape. The eldest son, CHI SHING (LAW MONG), is a simple and straightforward person. He has a good and helpful wife, CHOW MONA (SO YUK WAH, LOUISA).

programme.title: 锦绣良缘
programme.desc: 程家世代经营染布业，程父与元配早逝，程二太太上官丹凤﹝黄淑仪﹞一直当家作主，把家业打理得井井有条。 长子智盛﹝罗莽﹞性格戆直，娶得贤妻周梦娴﹝苏玉华﹞。次子智博﹝阮兆祥﹞为人急功近利，和锱铢必较的妻子薛小小﹝郭少芸﹞是对欢喜冤家。叁子智勇﹝郑中基﹞心地善良但只管吃喝玩乐，其妻郑艳﹝梅小惠﹞为人势利却爱夫心切。四子智轩博学多闻、温文尔雅，却要奉皇上圣旨跟率性不羁的吐蕃女子顿珠﹝文颂娴﹞成婚。智轩和顿珠性格迥异，时有争执，二人不但无夫妻之实，而且常常斗气，因而闹出不少笑话来。期间，智轩爱上女子周梦诗﹝邝文珣﹞，顿珠大方地从中撮合，智轩心存感激。及后梦诗移情别恋，智轩若有所失，顿珠从旁安慰，二人竟又渐生情愫。程家因得罪权贵而尽失祖业，智轩更因一个惊人的秘密而惹来杀身之祸……

programme.title: AI Romantic
programme.desc: High-end AI robot Bo (Ali Lee) accidentally loses her way while she is being shipped from the factory. She eventually ends up among a family of weirdos in the realm of human beings. AI company employee Koo Ka-lim (6 Wing) thinks he has found some treasure and arbitrarily keeps Bo for himself. To help four family members in the Koo household handle all kinds of strange tasks, Bo switches on her self-learning function and begins to experience myriad human emotions and desires.

programme.title: 智能爱人
programme.desc: 高端智能人阿宝(李佳芯饰)出厂时意外走失，流落人间，落入古怪寻常百姓家。人工智能公司职员古家廉(陆永饰)如获至宝，私下将阿宝据为己有。阿宝为协助古家四名家族成员执行各项奇怪任务，启动自我学习功能，自此尝尽人间百味的七情六欲，更爱上了主人家廉，体会情为何物。公司高层兼情敌多姐(冯盈盈饰)在公在私对阿宝穷追不舍，誓要把她彻底销毁！与此同时，阿宝却侦测到自己身中计算机病毒，生命正在倒数……

programme.title: Wonder Women
programme.desc: LAM FEI (Miriam Yeung) is a beautiful, trendy yet cheerful “Wonder Women” housewife. She and her husband, an architect SHEUNG KIM-HUNG (Raymond Wong) and a smart and active son SHEUNG KAI-KAI are living a happy life. LAM FEI has two buddies, a career woman, MAN FUNG-WAH (Alice Chan) and a pretty and wealthy wife MA SEE-LUI (Rebecca Zhu). Each of this trio has her own ideas about romance and encounter different up and down of love

programme.title: 多功能老婆
programme.desc: 蓝飞(杨千嬅饰)是一位美丽时尚、开朗率真的「多功能」主妇，有一个爱她的建筑师丈夫尚剑雄(黄浩然饰)，一个活泼聪明的儿子尚启佳，生活美满。蓝飞还有两位好闺密：女强人万风华(陈炜饰) 及美丽富太马思蕾(朱晨丽饰)，叁女的性格和爱情观南辕北辙，爱情路上各有起跌。剑雄全身投入开拓事业，被揭发出轨后抛妻弃子，出走内地。蓝飞像折翼堕地的天使，独力带着儿子生活，遂把没供完的新楼房分租，与高富帅租客荣浩田(周柏豪饰)经常斗气，笑料百出。机缘巧合下，蓝飞由煮妇变成名厨，浩田即化作双翼助她建立厨艺事业。女人因男人的绝情而枯萎，又因另一男人的深情而再次盛放。此时，剑雄回归复婚，浩田亦主动出击，叁角关系僵持不下！

programme.title: 地狱天使
programme.desc: 年轻貌美的儿（张可颐），牵涉毒杀富翁及争夺遗产，找来石（陈启泰）当其辩护律师。儿的背景神秘复杂，且于有意无意间对石作出挑逗，令石留下深刻印象。 原来儿为石妻珊（苏玉华）之同父异母姐妹。儿因痛恨珊母当年抢走其父，致儿母沦为妓女，儿更惨遭嫖客强奸。儿誓要向珊母女二人进行报复。儿接近石，是为要珊婚姻决裂，家破人亡。 在儿的精心布局下，石渐转投其怀抱。儿见目标已达，欲抽身离去，却惊觉自己爱上了石。此时，儿情人关（何英伟）利用儿陷害石作其替死鬼，以掩饰其商业罪行……

programme.title: Colourful Life
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. His mistress, SHUI KWUN DING FUNG (TSUI SUJK YEE), has since been running the business and keeps the family in shape. The eldest son, CHI SHING (LAW MONG), is a simple and straightforward person. He has a good and helpful wife, CHOW MONA (SO YUK WAH, LOUISA).

programme.title: 锦绣良缘
programme.desc: 程家世代经营染布业，程父与元配早逝，程二太太上官丹凤﹝黄淑仪﹞一直当家作主，把家业打理得井井有条。 长子智盛﹝罗莽﹞性格戆直，娶得贤妻周梦娴﹝苏玉华﹞。次子智博﹝阮兆祥﹞为人急功近利，和锱铢必较的妻子薛小小﹝郭少芸﹞是对欢喜冤家。叁子智勇﹝郑中基﹞心地善良但只管吃喝玩乐，其妻郑艳﹝梅小惠﹞为人势利却爱夫心切。四子智轩博学多闻、温文尔雅，却要奉皇上圣旨跟率性不羁的吐蕃女子顿珠﹝文颂娴﹞成婚。智轩和顿珠性格迥异，时有争执，二人不但无夫妻之实，而且常常斗气，因而闹出不少笑话来。期间，智轩爱上女子周梦诗﹝邝文珣﹞，顿珠大方地从中撮合，智轩心存感激。及后梦诗移情别恋，智轩若有所失，顿珠从旁安慰，二人竟又渐生情愫。程家因得罪权贵而尽失祖业，智轩更因一个惊人的秘密而惹来杀身之祸……

programme.title: AI Romantic
programme.desc: High-end AI robot Bo (Ali Lee) accidentally loses her way while she is being shipped from the factory. She eventually ends up among a family of weirdos in the realm of human beings. AI company employee Koo Ka-lim (6 Wing) thinks he has found some treasure and arbitrarily keeps Bo for himself. To help four family members in the Koo household handle all kinds of strange tasks, Bo switches on her self-learning function and begins to experience myriad human emotions and desires.
